ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels centrally distributed, 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the perimeter, tips, and central hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across both lobes. A distinct, high-contrast black circular 'eye' spot is located on the mid-outer portion of the left lobe. Black pigment forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and radiates in linear, mottled streaks from the central hinge (peduncle attachment).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees; the apex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitudes are most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes, featuring sharp peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite curve exhibiting slight convexity near the notch transitioning to a concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct circular black pixel cluster on the left lobe; a cluster of small, irregular high-contrast white/grey pixels on the extreme right tip indicates barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single diagonal linear black mark is visible on the upper-left lobe near the margin; vertical linear rake marks are visible on the right lobe radiating from the central hinge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly distinctive circular pigment mark on the left lobe; visible barnacle clusters on the far-right terminal edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'eye-like' circular black ocellus on the left lobe is a unique identifier not typical of standard fluke mottling.
